fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-07-03 (afternoon, 16:50): The complainant paid Rs. 40,000 for a grey motorcycle bearing registration number TN-68-YY-1058 sold as second-hand, but the ownership transfer was not completed and the seller became unreachable. The complainant, Arun Thangaraj, provided the contact number 9000000483. Praveen Sekar (mobile 9000000221) was named as a possible person of interest. Rajesh Rajan (9000000302) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly sold without a valid ownership transfer.
fields.Keywords: vehicle sale, cheating, motorcycle, afternoon, witness, documents, mobile number, main street
